step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identify nodes from visual diagram:
   - Top-left: EKS ('EKS') labeled 'EKS / MetaManager'
   - Below EKS: OpenSearch icon ('OpenSearch') labeled 'Elasticsearch / Neo4j'
   - Data Lake area:
     - S3 bucket ('S3') labeled 'S3 Data Lake'
     - Kafka box ('ThirdParty') labeled 'Kafka'
     - EMR box ('EMR') labeled 'EMR'
   - Bottom row:
     - Database icon ('OnPremDC') labeled 'Multiple Data Sources'
     - Applications puzzle icon ('ThirdParty') labeled 'Applications'
     - User icon ('UserCompanyAgent') labeled 'DA/DS'
   - Right column:
     - RDS icon ('RDS') labeled 'RDS'
     - Vertica icon ('ThirdParty') labeled 'Vertica'

2. Trace connections (edges) and directionality based on visible arrowheads:
   - Multiple Data Sources <-> Kafka (dual arrows: incoming and outgoing)
   - Applications <-> EMR (dual arrows: incoming and outgoing)
   - Kafka <-> S3 (dual arrows)
   - EMR <-> S3 (dual arrows)
   - EKS -> OpenSearch and OpenSearch -> EKS
   - EKS -> Kafka (pink control/meta line from MetaManager to Kafka)
   - S3 -> RDS (arrow from S3 to RDS)
   - EMR -> Vertica (arrow from EMR to Vertica)
   - Vertica -> S3 (arrow looping back up to S3)
   - Vertica -> DA/DS (arrow from Vertica to DA/DS user icon)
